title: Comms Plan
description: The part-by-part build plan for ONE channel of ONE change. Deliberately key-compatible with proposal_plan.json so the slide-deck channel renders through cm-proposal-generator's existing build_deck.py and render_html.py with no modification to either.

brief_ref.description: Path to the change_brief.json this plan draws on. The link that lets one brief serve many channel runs.

channel.description: Exactly one per run. Cross-channel consistency comes from the shared brief, never from copying text between drafts.

client.description: Read by render_html.py for slide footers.

engagement_title.description: The change title. render_html.py builds the HTML <title> from client + engagement_title, so populate both for the deck channel.

target_audience_ids.description: Which segments THIS run addresses. Coverage is computed against this subset, not the whole brief — a single-audience email must not fail for omitting messages aimed elsewhere.

template.description: Required for the slide_deck channel only. Point at the run-local branded copy produced by apply_brand.py, not at the shared template.

slide_budget.description: Permitted but discouraged. render_html.py's over-limit warning is worded 'exceeds the RFP limit', which is nonsense in a comms run. Use brand_profile.channel_specs.slide_deck.max_slides and let qa_comms.py report it instead.

message_ids.description: The analogue of proposal_plan's requirement_ids. Nothing in the render path reads this field, so the rename is free.

slides.description: One output unit each — a slide for slide_deck, a titled part for the other three channels. The key is named 'slides' on purpose: renaming it would force a change to build_deck.py, and that compatibility is what buys the deck channel for free.

part_kind.description: Shapes the markdown output and drives the channel-spec checks in Stage 4.

layout.description: Required for slide_deck only. Must name a layout present in the template profile.

speaker_notes.description: Every content slide in a cascade deck needs these. A deck without notes gets improvised, and the improvisation is what the audience remembers.

placeholder.description: Placeholder name from the template profile. Required for the slide_deck channel; ignored by the markdown renderer.

kind.description: Same vocabulary as proposal_plan, so one plan renders to both markdown and HTML. 'table' carries a video shot list; 'phases' carries a milestone timeline.

sources.description: Provenance. Each entry is either a knowledge-bank entry ID or a 'brief:<dotted.path>' reference into change_brief.json. MUST be non-empty unless gap is true. See SKILL.md — this skill has THREE valid provenance states, not the proposal generator's two.

gap.description: True when neither the bank nor the brief covers it. Renders as a visible [GAP]; never substitute generated filler.

gap_note.description: Required when gap is true — what is missing and which message or action it leaves exposed.
